scope: Source art candidates; preserves application checkpoint; canonical intake pending Mac.
layout_policy: Shared empty seasonal foundation plus separate generated RGBA fence components; plants/pots/furniture are independent future placeables. Composite previews are flattened evidence, not separated art sources.
review_policy: Actual alpha, extraction geometry, 960/384 display and joins inspected. Metric dimensions, snap endpoints and perches provisional until Mac fit. No additional retries for small defects.
season_policy: Every yard has spring/summer/autumn/winter. Mild coastal San Diego winter, no default snow. Fence material is static year-round; seasonal yard ground/sky varies.
implementation_limits: No wind/physics or bird behavior implementation
No usable open gate state until additional art exists
